Photo 2 shows 'Intel(R) Core(TM)2 Duo CPU E8400 @ 3.00GHz' in the system properties window, not 2.92GHz.
Photo 2 shows '6.00 GB' under 'Installed Memory (RAM)' in the system properties window.
No webcam is visible in any photo. The screen shows a Windows 10 desktop, but no camera hardware is shown.
The system properties in photo 2 do not show GPU details. No NVIDIA branding or driver info is visible. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the photos.
